titulo: What Happens to a Spider After You Knock Down Its Web?
titulos_alternativos: Why the Spider Web on Your Porch Is Always Back by Morning
You Swept the Web. Here's What the Spider Did Next
descripcion:
It is late. You step out on the porch and walk face first into a spider web. You grab the broom and wipe out every thread. The next morning, the web is back. Same spot. Perfect circle. So what did that spider go through last night?

Why a web is a spider's home, fridge and job all in one, the safety line that saves its life, how it rebuilds overnight by eating the old web, when a spider finally gives up and moves, the secret of dusty cobwebs, and what to do with a web across your front door.
